sources.title: When is permission required?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Permitted development rights are a national grant of planning permission subject to conditions and limitations; Article 4 directions can remove specified rights in defined areas.

sources.title: Permitted development rights for householders: technical guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Householder permitted development rights remain subject to detailed limits, conditions, designated-area restrictions and any Article 4 direction or planning-condition removal of rights.

sources.title: Lawful development certificates
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: A lawful development certificate can confirm an existing or proposed use or operation is lawful for planning purposes, but it is precise to the described state or proposal and does not remove other regulatory requirements.

sources.title: Find out if you need planning permission
sources.verified_claim: Enfield notes permitted development may apply but restrictions can arise from property type, conservation status, listed status or earlier planning conditions and recommends a lawful development certificate where appropriate.

sources.title: Article 4 directions
sources.verified_claim: Enfield publishes CSV, GeoJSON and GPKG Article 4 direction locations. A direction is spatially defined and cannot be attributed to parcel_30762 without exact intersection.

sources.title: Permitted development rights and restrictions
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains that flats, conservation areas, listed buildings, planning conditions and Article 4 directions can restrict permitted development rights.

sources.title: Article 4 Directions
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth maintains Article 4 directions withdrawing specified permitted development rights, including change-of-use rights, across defined areas.

sources.title: Article 4 directions withdrawing Class MA permitted development rights
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth records Class MA directions restricting Class E to C3 change-of-use permitted development in mapped areas; applicability depends on exact site location and proposal facts.
